Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hey, you're late!
Huh？ ●, I'm not... late, am I？
Don't worry. It's not even our meet-up time yet？
Whew. But looks like I kept you waiting anyway. Sorry.
Not at all. I just wanted to see you a little sooner♪
Anegasaki
Please stop. I'm waiting for someone.
Ugh, talk about persistent...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Ah, there you are.
Was that guy trying to sell you something？
Yep. Honestly, who'd ever go along with those guys？
Sorry, it's because ● was running late...
It's not your fault at all. You're right on time. See？
(It's almost time. I wonder where ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is...)
Whoa...
Anegasaki
Guess who~♪
It's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, right？
Aw, it's no fun if you guess it right away.
Haha, did you want me to get it wrong？
Nope. If you said another girl's name, I'd go right home.
There's no way I'd ever mistake ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is late. I hope nothing happened...)
Anegasaki
I'm so sorry!
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
It took forever to get ready, and before I knew it, it was time to leave! Then I ran and my shoe came off...
Don't make that face. As long as you're okay, it's totally fine.
Seeing your face made all the tension just melt away... ...I'm really sorry.
It's fine, really. Here.
...Yeah.
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Whoa, what's this all of a sudden？
I got here a bit early, and wandering around alone just made me feel lonely.
...Sorry for leaving you alone.
You're right on time. I was just being selfish▼
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Alright, let's go.
...Hehe.
What's wrong？
It just feels so natural. Meeting up like this, walking side by side... all of it.
Well, we are dating, after all.
I don't think it'd feel this way just because we're dating, though.
(I got here way too early. Maybe I'll walk around a bit to kill some time...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You're early.
You too! Jeez, and here I was looking forward to enjoying the wait before you got here.
Haha, I guess that's one way to enjoy it.
Of course？ Waiting is half the fun of a date, you know.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ got here first today, huh？
When you say 'today,' it makes it sound like I'm always late, you know？
I didn't mean it that way, though.
I'm gonna beat you here next time too. When I do, you'd better admit defeat, okay？
Uhh...
(Wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ will be here soon...)
(Oh, it's from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
Anegasaki
Hello.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What's up？
Ta-da! I'm here.
...Huh？ Why call, then...？
Mmm, no real reason. I just wanted to hear your voice as soon as I could. Is that so bad？
Haha, works for me. I thought something had happened, though.
(Ah, there's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。
Anegasaki
Zero!
...Zero？
I figured you'd be here any second, so I counted down in my head. It was almost spot-on!
Really？ That's impressive.
It felt just like, ta-da! My intuition might be extra sharp today♪
Anegasaki
Hey, aren't you thirsty？ How about getting some tea？
Yeah, let's go.
Anegasaki
We've got time, right？ Let's have some tea.
Yeah, it was.
Anegasaki
Hey, aren't you thirsty？ I'd love to grab a drink.
Yeah, well then...
Is this place okay？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, do you remember？
What is it？
About Valentine's Day.
Valentine's, huh...
Anegasaki
White Day...
Hm, White Day？
It just popped into my head. Do you remember that time？
White Day, huh...
Anegasaki
Oh, I just remembered.
What？
Christmas. It was so wonderful...
Christmas, huh...
Anegasaki
Hey, I just remembered. My birthday.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday？
I was just so happy. Do you remember that day？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday, huh...
Anegasaki
What should we do next...
Hm？ What is it？
Your birthday. It just suddenly came back to me.
●'s birthday, huh...
Anegasaki
...I still think about it sometimes.
What？
Our anniversary from when we started dating. We celebrated it, right？
The anniversary for ● and me, huh...
You said little things can make you anxious, right？
You said timing and mood matter a lot, right？
You said misunderstandings are just spice in a romance, right？
（ＲＴＣ－ＡＤＶ）
You said you were being childish, right？
You said ● was making a pathetic face, right？
You said our gallery of memories is growing, right？
（ＲＴＣ－ＡＤＶ）
You said you wanted to stay together even a minute longer, right？
You said counting the days until Christmas is fun, right？
You said ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was your present, right？
（ＲＴＣ－ＡＤＶ）
You said you'd never forget it, right？
You said there wasn't any room to nitpick, right？
You said it makes you never want to go home, right？
（ＲＴＣ－ＡＤＶ）
You said cooking for us might just become second nature, right？
You said the prep time was fun too, right？
You said you were so glad I was born, right？
（ＲＴＣ－ＡＤＶ）
You said you couldn't stop feeling grateful, right？
You told me you were glad you met ●, right？
You said you were in the mood to be spoiled, right？
（ＲＴＣ－ＡＤＶ）
Anegasaki
That's it... Good boy, ▼.
There's no way I'd forget.
Anegasaki
...That's not it, is it？
...Have I？
Jeez, you need to cherish our memories, too.
(I've really gotta remember these things...)
Anegasaki
Hey, let's make lots more memories, okay？ Going to new places, eating good food...
Yeah. Let's go on lots of dates.
...And lots of kisses, too, okay？
Yes...
Anegasaki
I wonder where we'll go from here？
...What do you mean？
Like the future and all... But... yeah, let's just focus on right now.
Anegasaki
I feel like the more I fall in love with you, the more anxious I get...
Anxious？ Why's that？
Like I'm so happy that it can only go downhill. I'm just overthinking things. Sorry.
...Don't apologize. I'm sure there are even happier times waiting for us.
Anegasaki
Have you ever wondered what you'd be doing right now if we'd never met？
Huh？ Well, we did meet, so... I can't really imagine it.
I think about it. But then it scares me and I stop. I'm so glad we met...
Anegasaki
Hey, stay by my side. Don't ever leave me, okay？
Where did this come from？
It's not that I'm anxious, it's just... being this close to you is what I love most...
...Yeah. ● too...
Anegasaki
I'm so happy it's scary. I wouldn't mind just fading away like this...
Don't say such ominous things.
It's okay, because if I vanish, I'll be with you. I won't be lonely at all.
I guess that doesn't sound so bad...
Anegasaki
Hey, look at me？ Keep looking... don't take your eyes off me.
Yeah... What is it？
Doing this, it feels like it's just the two of us. See？ I'm the only thing reflected in your eyes.
Anegasaki
Hey, you never try to keep me from leaving on dates. Why is that？
Well, I mean...
Fufu, sorry to put you on the spot. When we're older, let's be together way longer, okay？ Forever and ever, deal？
Yeah, forever...
Anegasaki
Do you think I've changed since I met you？ What do you think？
Hard to say, since I'm always looking at you...
I'm not really sure either. Though I can say for sure that I'm way happier now.
That goes for ●, too...
Anegasaki
They say whoever falls in love loses. Does that mean I'm on a total losing streak？
You think？ Maybe ●'s the one who lost.
Fufu, who knows？ Though losing to you wouldn't bother me one bit. That's how much I love you ▼
Anegasaki
Mm, look how early it still is.
What's up？ Do you have plans after this？
No way... As if I'd make plans! Just checking that we can still stay together longer.
True. We've still got plenty of time together today.
Anegasaki
Oh, it's still so early.
Yeah, we're just getting started.
All right! You're hanging out with me for a lot longer, okay？
Haha, go easy on me.
Anegasaki
We still have plenty of time.
Of course I did.
Fufu, that makes me happy. We get to spend so much time together.
Yeah, I'm sticking with you until the last second.
Anegasaki
You're still free for today, right？
Time-wise？ Yeah, it's still pretty early.
I'm so glad. I want to be with you for even just one minute longer.
Yeah, let's stay together as long as we can.
Anegasaki
You're staying with me all the way today, okay？
If you're fine with it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, for as long as you want.
Mm-hmm. You really spoil me, you know that ▼
Hmm, do I？
Anegasaki
Hey, our day is just getting started, right？
Okay, I know.
Even if you say you want to go home, I won't let you go.
No way, I'd never say that.
Anegasaki
Do we still have some time？
I don't mind, ● but...
Then why don't we rest at the park for a bit？
Yeah, sure.
Anegasaki
Hey, let's take a break at the park nearby.
Are you okay on time？
I'm the one suggesting it, so of course it's fine.
All right~
Anegasaki
Tired？ Let's take a break. There's a park nearby.
Yeah, sounds good.
Mm, good boy. Just a girl's heart wanting to be with you a little bit longer.
Ah, so that's what it was.
Anegasaki
Can we take a detour？ Why don't we rest at the park for a bit？
If you're okay with it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ I'm fine with that.
Don't worry about the time. I'm just worried about you getting home too late.
I'm fine, you really don't need to worry about that.
Anegasaki
Come on, you're good, right？ Let's stop by the park, then.
Yeah, let's take a break.
A park at night is a classic for couples, right？
Really？
Anegasaki
Hey, I'd like to drop by the park for a bit.
Sure, let's go rest a bit.
Yeah! ▼I still have so much more I want to talk about.
It's funny, even though we've been together all day.
Anegasaki
Hey, don't you think we've been going on a lot of dates lately？
Yeah. You think it's too much？
No way. Absolutely not. I wouldn't even mind if it were every single day.
I see. That's good, then.
Still... whether it's a date or running into each other, anything's fine as long as I'm with you. Every single moment is precious to me.
You're making me blush...
Fufu, made you blush. Going on so many dates, and seeing your cute side... I'm so spoiled, aren't I？
● always worry about keeping ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ satisfied, though.
Anegasaki
Have we not been going on as many dates lately？
...You think so？
Yeah. We see each other at school and Dixie's, but that alone isn't... you know？
I see. I'll try to be more mindful of that.
Ah, I'm not blaming you! Your own time is important, too, and it's not like my feelings for you change just because we can't see each other...
Still, I might've made you feel lonely. I'm sorry.
Anegasaki
You've been quite the lonely boy lately, haven't you？
●？ You think so...？
Well, you've been calling me out a lot, you know.
That's just... I only wanted to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
That can't be all, right？ You spoiled boy.
Lonely and spoiled...？
I'm happy about it, you know？ It hurts more when you hold back. Being lonely and spoiled is totally fine.
All right. If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is fine with that, I am too.
Anegasaki
I've been feeling kind of lonely lately, you know？
Why？
Because you haven't been asking me out as much lately.
Am I like that...？
Ah, you didn't even notice. That's so mean~, I feel so lonely~.
Sorry...
Did I put you on the spot？▼ Don't worry, it's not like I don't feel cherished. After all, we're on a date together right now.
Still, I must've made you feel lonely. I'm sorry.
Anegasaki
You've been pretty forward lately, haven't you？
Does that mean... maybe I've been too touchy-feely？
I wouldn't say too much？ Just that we've had a lot of physical affection.
Hmm, maybe I should tone it down a bit.
Jeez, that's not it at all. It's totally normal for couples to be all over each other.
Then... should I not worry and do it even more...？
...Yeah. Fine by me？
I see...
Anegasaki
Hey, am I not attractive to you？
What!? No way, that's not true at all!
Well, you haven't touched me much lately...
Well, I just thought being too hands-on might be a bit much, you know...
Honestly... You're being way too careful with me.
...You think so？
It is. I want to feel you so much more.
Yeah... I guess I was just a little embarrassed, too.
Anegasaki
Hey, you've been kissing me a lot lately, haven't you？
...Is it a little too much？
Not at all. You could never kiss me too much—only too little.
I see. That's a relief, then.
So you really like kissing, huh？
Well, yeah... What about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I like it too. In fact, I might even love it.
If it makes ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ happy, then I'm glad.
Anegasaki
You haven't been kissing me very much, have you？
...Why do you ask all of a sudden？
It's not sudden. I've been thinking about it for a while now.
I see... Does ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like kissing？
Love you.
● just thought being too pushy might be bad...
...You're way too sweet. Instead of always worrying, it's okay to be a little more selfish, you know？
Anegasaki
You always look like you're enjoying my cooking so much.
Not just look like it— it really is delicious.
It's not really something to praise that much, is it？
That's not true. At least, not to ●.
Mm, that makes me happy... Maybe that means we're really compatible？
Maybe so. At this rate, I won't be able to live without ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking.
Geez, don't go getting carried away.
I mean it. Your cooking's great, but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ making it just for ● is what makes me the happiest.
Anegasaki
You're always so clear about what you like to eat, aren't you？
Sorry... I complain a lot, even though you went through the trouble of cooking.
Ah... sorry, not like that! I meant that it actually makes me happy.
It makes you happy？
Yeah. Because doesn't it kind of feel like...
...like we're a married couple... don't you think？
(A married couple, huh...)
Anegasaki
Hey, you take photos of me pretty often, don't you？
Do I？ ...Yeah, maybe I do.
Fufu, you definitely do.
Um, you don't mind it, do you？
Well, I think I like it. It feels like you're taking the lead.
Oh, that's good then.
No holding back, okay？ Getting dragged around by you might be just right.
(Is that how it is...？)
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, you don't take photos very often, do you？
Well, yeah. Should I take more？
You don't need to force it. Even without a photo, the memories are still real.
Yeah, I'll just snap them when I'm in the mood. Smile for me then, okay？
Will do! Let's just go at our own pace, okay？
Right, nice and easy.
Fufu, taking it easy together makes us feel like an old married couple ▼
Yeah, you might be right.
Anegasaki
You know, I wouldn't mind if you molded me to your tastes a bit more.
Huh？ What do you mean？
Fashion. You never really make requests.
Really？ It just seems like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ already knows what suits her best...
...I see. Maybe our tastes are just pretty similar, then？
That's it. We're two peas in a pod.
Fufu, two peas in a pod, huh？ Well, I guess that can't be helped.
Exactly. It already suits you, so no need to force a change.
Anegasaki
Am I slowly becoming more your type？
Eh？
Ah, sorry, fashion-wise! You give me a lot of notes, so I wondered if I'm okay.
Do I？ ...Sorry.
Don't apologize! I'm actually happy about it.
...You are？
Because you're so upfront, when you DO compliment me, I know you really mean it.
I see. As long as you're fine with it.
Anegasaki
You've been texting me a lot lately, haven't you？
Ah, if it's annoying...
No way! Every time I get a text from you, it makes me so happy.
That would be nice...
Oh, there's just one catch. Whenever you say something cute, I just want to see you.
...Do ● really say things that cute？
You do, all the time! You don't even realize it, huh.
(Do I really, though？)
Anegasaki
I haven't heard my text chime very often lately...
Eh？
I wonder why... And here I'm supposed to have a boyfriend.
Sorry, I haven't been texting much, have I...？
Yeah... But don't push yourself. If you look that down, I'll just feel guilty.
Well, whenever I text you, it makes me want to see you...
...Aw, that's not fair. How can I beg for texts when you say things like that？
Haha, sorry.
Anegasaki
You've been studying up on me lately, haven't you？
Studying up？
Like the foods and drinks I like. On our dates, you always take me to places I love, right？
Well, that's the least I can do.
Pulling that off so casually earns you major points, you know？
Is that so？
Yep! As your girlfriend, I couldn't be prouder.
Haha, I'm just glad it makes you happy.
Anegasaki
You know, lately you've been acting a little... wild.
Wild？ In what way？
Well... you're a little forceful when you touch me？ It catches me off guard sometimes.
Oh, that's what you mean... Sorry, I'll be more careful.
Mmm, I'd like to tell you to, but part of me kind of doesn't want you to, either...
There's a part of me that likes it when you're forceful. Just thinking about it makes my heart flutter.
...Uh, so I guess I'll just be moderately careful, then？
Anegasaki
...Hmm？
It's because you're like that that I love you.
No, not just that. Everything wrapped together, I just really love you.
Anegasaki
I guess that's another thing I love about you.
Why？
That part of you is just another reason why I love you.
...Pretty straightforward, huh？ But it's the truth.
Anegasaki
Hey.
...Hmm？
I love you. That part of you, the flawed parts, all of it— I love everything about you.
Don't give me that blank look. Are you trying to make me say it more？
Anegasaki
I want to be with you forever...
Eh？
I want to be with you forever. If you don't mind... I want to stay right by your side.
Mind？ Never. There's no way you'd be a bother.
...Thank you. That makes me so happy...
Anegasaki
It's your fault, for being the way you are.
Huh？ Did ● do something？
You did, plenty! And thanks to that, I ended up falling for you even more.
So you'd better take responsibility, okay？
Anegasaki
When I sit back and think about you like this...
...Hmm？
I really am completely head over heels for you...
Is that so...？
It really is. Honestly, you're too much.
Anegasaki
I really do love you...
You know, hearing this might put you on the spot, but...
...Hmm？
I never want us to be apart. Please don't ever fall out of love with me.
Yes...
Anegasaki
*sigh* When you're like that, I just fall for you more and more.
Look at you, making me say all these embarrassing things.
Um... sorry, I guess.
Hehe, oh you.
Anegasaki
I can't stop now.
Eh？
You being like this is why I can't stop falling in love with you.
Then again... hehe, maybe not stopping is just fine.
Anegasaki
Mm... sorry. These are happy tears... I had no idea a date could make someone this happy... My heart's just so full...
Anegasaki
I never want to let you go... I want to keep you all to myself forever. *sigh*... I love you... I love you so much.
Anegasaki
I love you! I love you so much▼ The whole date today, I was so in love with you... I felt like I was losing my mind.
Anegasaki
Just this one date is enough to keep me loving you for a lifetime. And yet, you've given me so many other memories, too... Am I allowed to be this happy？
Anegasaki
Can I even keep acting like the older girlfriend at this rate？ When you make me this happy, I've completely lost... Ugh, I'm so happy it's almost annoying...
Anegasaki
So cute... You're always cute, but you were especially adorable today▼ Just looking at you made me so happy.
Anegasaki
It was so fun, it felt like a dream... I'm so glad I'm your girlfriend.
Anegasaki
When you pull off a date this perfectly, what can I even say？ Today was so much fun. Thank you▼
Anegasaki
That was so much fun~♪ The best date ever▼ Making me fall this hard for you, what are you trying to do to me？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Why do we have to go home？ When I love you this much, and don't want to leave...
...Never mind. Hey, kiss me one more time？ Please.
Anegasaki
I want to stay together longer...
But it's getting late...
...I know. That's why...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I shouldn't keep you any longer, right？ ...Bye-bye.
Anegasaki
Well then, good night. Thank you so much for today.
Yeah, good night.
Anegasaki
I guess this is as late as we can push it. We really have to head home.
Yeah. See you.
Anegasaki
I want to stay like this longer, but... we have to head home, don't we？
...Yeah. Good night.
Anegasaki
All right. Get home safe, okay？
Okay, see you.
Anegasaki
And... that's a wrap! See you later.
I guess I'll go.
Anegasaki
Hehe, love you▼ See ya.
Yeah, good night.
Anegasaki
Look at all these people... Even though there's still quite a while until the light-up.
Maybe no one can wait？ Just like us, ●.
Could be. I wonder what time the lights turn on？
Probably once the sun goes all the way down.
I see. In that case, we better enjoy the evening blossoms while we still can.
Even though we're gonna see them tonight, too？
Evening is evening, and night is night, right？ Look, the sunset is turning them so red.
Your face is red from the sunset too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Geez... Look at the cherry blossoms, not me.
All right~
Good. ...Hehe, your face is turning red too.
Aren't you supposed to look at the blossoms, not ●？
Okaay. ...Hehe.
Anegasaki
It's beautiful...
Whoa, it really is totally different from the evening.
The blossoms stand out so white against the pitch-black sky. It's so magical...
Are you crying？
It's just... they're so beautiful, and...
Sorry for startling you. I'm just really touched, that's all.
Yeah, you surprised me a bit, but...
Maybe I get like this because I'm next to you.
Next to ●？ Why？
I think... probably because I'm just so happy... Beautiful things look even more beautiful, and it touches me so much more than being alone...
...I see.
So instead of tears of joy, maybe they're tears of happiness...
● was glad to see it with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, too.
...If you say that, you'll make me cry again.
Sorry...
...Then give me a tight hug, and I'll forgive you.
...Yeah.
...So warm. ...Hey, I love you.
Yeah, me too...
Anegasaki
Wow! Look, look!
Hm？ Where, where？
The view from here is just like a postcard. The sunset, the autumn leaves, the shrine, and...
And ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, too...
Hehe, oh you.
Haha, but it really is beautiful.
Right？ This is probably the best time of day.
The main event is the night light-up, right？
That's true. ...Still, shrines at night feel a little spooky, don't they？
There'll be plenty of people, so it's fine. Besides, you have ● with you, too.
Yeah. As long as you're with me, I'd be fine even if it was just the two of us in a pitch-black graveyard.
About that... hmm...
Ah, you're scared, aren't you？
That's not... well, maybe.
Hehe. Hey, want to walk around the shrine grounds？
Sure. But graveyards are off-limits, okay？
I told you, we're not going.
Anegasaki
Wow...
It really is incredible...
It looks so different lit up, doesn't it？ Almost like it's not even from this world...
When ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ says it, it kind of sounds like horror.
I didn't mean it like that. ...Still, you're right. Lured in by this light...
Haha, I knew it. If anything showed up here, it'd be a Japanese yokai.
...Hey, aren't ghosts and yokai usually portrayed as beautiful women？
Is that so？
I feel like they are. ............
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I feel like there are a lot of beauties around today, too. Especially gorgeous older women.
Really？ Let me see...
Hey！
Eh？
Look only at me.
No looking at pretty ladies, or beautiful yokai, or ghosts. Look only at me.
Yeah. I'm only looking at ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
And I'll only look at you, too...
We've still got plenty of time before the movie starts.
Anegasaki
Yeah... Oh, this movie looks interesting.
Hm？ Which one？
It says 'An invitation to a dream world.' Looks like it combines live-action and animation.
Huh... Come to think of it, I might've seen a commercial for it on TV.
...Looking around like this makes me want to see even more movies.
Yeah. Same with the trailers before the movie starts.
Right？ It's a conspiracy by the movie theaters？
I think it's just regular advertising, but... Haha, a conspiracy, huh？
Hey, mean of you to laugh! Fine, then I'll just go see this movie all by myself.
Sorry, sorry! Let's go together.
Hmm, whatever should I do~？
Don't whine like that. My cute ▼.
These are pretty good seats. Not too close, not too far...
Anegasaki
If you're too close to the screen, your neck starts hurting, right？
Yeah. It's intense, but...
Ah.
...You okay？
Yeah... That ending was so touching. *sigh* I ended up crying...
● almost lost it, too...
It would've been fine to cry. There were plenty of guys crying too, you know？
Well, yeah, but...
So you held it in. Would you hold back even if it was just the two of us？
...Maybe.
I really wouldn't mind at all. In fact, I could've given you a gentle 'there, there.'
